title: 15 kW Emergency Power for Mobile ICUs
copy: Customised "ThOR" BESS for ambulances, field operation theatres and disaster teams — 6–10 hours of clean, silent power.
note: Approved for MVP · Dept. of Science & Technology, Gujarat · IMA partner

title: Tactical Power for Defence Mobility
copy: A clean-energy field supply unit replacing diesel generators — 12–18 hours off-grid, vehicle-mounted or air-dropped, powering drones, radar and command centres.

title: Agri e-Generator for Irrigation

note: Ministry of Agriculture · AIC Delhi, NITI Aayog

title: LFP-based Portable Induction Cooking
copy: Solar-charged induction hot-plates in three models (LD/MD/HD) replacing LPG in rural homes and commercial kitchens — levelised cost of ₹3.85 per kWh over a 12-year life.
